conceptChallenge: All21 grouped families and actual slide text, arrows, screenshots and labels checked. Core sensing, contextual fusion, software/hardware boundaries, expression pipeline, streaming, prompts, graph and applications are represented. Three bounded integrative/causal angles remain; page-level citation coverage does not establish complete question coverage.

remainingBoundedGaps.title: Integrated interruption and conversation-state trace
remainingBoundedGaps.finding: Current items separately recognize event types, compute queued audio and deduplicate expression labels, but never carry a bounded interruption through client playback and conversational state.
remainingBoundedGaps.remedy: Replace P1789-Q04 with a supplied event trace containing an active response, speech-start, queued old audio and a late old-response chunk. Declare cancellation, queue clearing, response-ID filtering and conversation truncation policy. Ask for final audible output/state. Exact API mechanics beyond the source must be explicitly supplied and source-qualified, not represented as printed code.

remainingBoundedGaps.title: Joint resource and freshness feasibility
remainingBoundedGaps.finding: Bandwidth, worker capacity, timing and score-age eligibility are only tested separately. No item decides whether a complete proposed operating point can satisfy them together.
remainingBoundedGaps.remedy: Replace repeated P1798-Q05 with a bounded comparison of candidate rates/configurations under supplied USB payload, sequential inference, buffering/drop and freshness conditions. Require the combined feasible choice or justified fallback, not merely another isolated unit substitution. State all added model assumptions.

remainingBoundedGaps.title: Full graph causal fault propagation
remainingBoundedGaps.finding: Direct color, detector, emotion and text edges are tested individually, but the depth-to-detector edge and alternative visualization paths are not used in a whole-graph failure analysis.
remainingBoundedGaps.remedy: Add one scenario that traces explicitly declared node/topic failures through the actual graph, including detector depth/color inputs, annotation output and emotion/dialogue text paths. State required inputs and failure policy because arrows alone do not prove execution dependencies. Ask which visible products can persist and what diagnostic observation distinguishes failures; do not infer an unprinted ROS implementation.

excludedPages.1801: Bibliography only; no linked course notebook or program

qualifications: Facial expression estimates and scores are not established internal states, calibrated probabilities, measured accuracy or diagnosis.
Six functional roles versus five displayed nodes is an abstraction difference, not an invented missing process.
RGB-D acquisition does not prove a four-channel expression-network tensor.
Conceptual voice diagrams do not mandate a separate complete transcript cascade or exclusive WebSocket transport.
Finite buffering, GPU use, asynchronous nodes, QoS or multimodality do not guarantee latency, synchronization, uninterrupted output or accuracy.
Screenshots and demonstration photo are historical illustrations, not newly run hardware benchmarks.
No executable source program or launch file is supplied in these pages; review computations are explicitly supplied models, not a live demonstration.
difficulty: Current easy and medium classifications are proportionate to their actual reasoning; do not relabel recall to manufacture hard coverage. The three genuine integrated gaps can support higher reasoning difficulty.
